name: cache_key_order_mismatch
title: Invalidate cached searches when a product changes
body: Product edits now call invalidate() with the filters of the searches that include the product.
diff:
### catalog/cache.py (modified, +5/-0)
@@ -15,3 +15,8 @@
     result = run(filters)
     redis.set(key, json.dumps(result), ex=600)
     return result
+
+
+def invalidate(filters: dict) -> None:
+    """Drop the cached result for these filters after a product changes."""
+    redis.delete("search:" + json.dumps(filters))

defects.what: the key is built without sort_keys=True, unlike search_key, so filters given in a different key order never match and stale results stay cached
